purpose: Controlled mapping register for the Twinstone normalised observation model to IES4 + Twinstone extensions. 'confirmed' means the superclass/reuse decision is intentionally asserted; 'pending' means no IES superclass is guessed.

rules.identity: observation URI from source-domain stable key; runtime URN retained as tw:runtimeId
rules.notes: tw:ObservationEvent remains an IES Event compatibility class in the browser exporter. v1.9 must test whether each source domain maps more correctly to an IES State, Event, documentation/evidence pattern, or a combination.

rules.iesPattern: observation is an ies:Event through tw:ObservationEvent; aircraft entity superclass remains pending
rules.notes: Do not guess an IES aircraft superclass until checked against the deployed/current IES common ontology.
rules.targetWorldModel: persistent entity + time-bounded IES State/Location pattern; source observation retained as provenance/evidence record

rules.iesPattern: entity reuses ies:Ship; observation remains a Twinstone event extension
rules.targetWorldModel: persistent entity + time-bounded IES State/Location pattern; source observation retained as provenance/evidence record

rules.iesPattern: persistent vessel entity reuses ies:Ship; GFW event remains a Twinstone observation/event extension with source semantics and provenance
rules.entityIdentity: GFW vessel id where present, otherwise MMSI/ssvid
rules.notes: AIS-derived activity history, not live vessel-position telemetry. Apparent fishing, encounter, loitering, port visit and AIS-gap classifications retain GFW semantics/caveats and do not independently establish confirmed fishing, transshipment, deliberate disabling, intent or wrongdoing.
rules.targetWorldModel: persistent ies:Ship entity + source activity event with explicit temporal/location/provenance; later CORE mapper may refine activity state/event relationships

rules.iesPattern: estimate is an ies:Event through tw:ObservationEvent; satellite entity superclass remains pending
rules.notes: Position is a derived SGP4 estimate; source element epoch must remain explicit.
rules.targetWorldModel: persistent entity + time-bounded IES State/Location pattern; source observation retained as provenance/evidence record

rules.notes: Catalogue record is metadata; imagery pixels are not automatically interpreted.

rules.notes: Thermal anomaly/cluster is not cause, strike, explosion, damage or attribution.

namespaceStatus: PoC namespace only; replace with an organisation-controlled resolvable namespace before production CORE publication.
semanticBoundary: The current normalized observation envelope is not assumed to be the final IES world model. The v1.9 mapper should split persistent entities, IES States/Events/Periods/Locations and source evidence/provenance where appropriate.

mappings.decision: Analyst-defined AOI is a Twinstone analytical context rather than a source-world entity/event. Do not coerce it into an IES event merely for convenience.
mappings.identity: session investigation id; export remains optional until notebook/case semantics are formalised.

mappings.decision: Analyst-authored work product is kept separate from source-world observations. Future CORE deployment must apply appropriate authorship/provenance and security policy.
Reference edge to an existing stable knowledge identity; not a duplicate observation or corroboration source.
Deterministic analytical product over supplied evidence; must not be modelled as a source-world event or threat classification.
Deterministic analytical comparison with explicit source-coverage metadata; absence caused by insufficient lookback must remain distinguishable from zero observations.
Context is kept outside the source-world observation/corroboration model until a domain-specific mapping is justified. Context does not increase corroboration scores by default.
IODA connectivity events remain contextual evidence about network reachability; no causal or physical-event mapping is asserted.
NOAA SWPC measurements/alerts are global environmental context in this PoC; do not infer local causal relationships automatically.
ReliefWeb records are reported-information/context resources; source authorship/provenance must remain explicit.
WHO Disease Outbreak News records are public-health reporting/context resources, not local sensor observations.

presentationViews.timelineReplay: query-time/session view only; not asserted as source knowledge
